tools.name: reclaim_get_current_user
tools.description: Get the authenticated Reclaim user's profile. Reclaim REST: GET /api/users/me.

tools.name: reclaim_list_tasks
tools.description: List the authenticated user's tasks. Reclaim REST: GET /api/tasks.

tools.name: reclaim_get_task
tools.description: Get a single task by id. Reclaim REST: GET /api/tasks/{id}.

tools.name: reclaim_list_habits
tools.description: List the authenticated user's daily habits. Reclaim REST: GET /api/assist/habits/daily.

tools.name: reclaim_get_habit
tools.description: Get a single daily habit by id. Reclaim REST: GET /api/assist/habits/daily/{id}.

tools.name: reclaim_list_events
tools.description: List calendar events. Reclaim REST: GET /api/events. Optional start/end window.

tools.name: reclaim_create_task
tools.description: Create a new task. Reclaim schedules it into your calendar automatically. Reclaim REST: POST /api/tasks.

tools.name: reclaim_update_task
tools.description: Update fields on an existing task. Only provided fields are changed. Reclaim REST: PATCH /api/tasks/{id}.

tools.name: reclaim_mark_task_complete
tools.description: Mark a task as done in the planner. Reclaim REST: POST /api/planner/done/task/{id}.

tools.name: reclaim_mark_task_incomplete
tools.description: Reopen a completed task (unarchive) in the planner. Reclaim REST: POST /api/planner/unarchive/task/{id}.

tools.name: reclaim_start_task
tools.description: Start time-tracking on a task now. Reclaim REST: POST /api/planner/start/task/{id}.

tools.name: reclaim_stop_task
tools.description: Stop time-tracking on a task. Reclaim REST: POST /api/planner/stop/task/{id}.

tools.name: reclaim_add_time
tools.description: Add scheduled time to a task. Reclaim REST: POST /api/planner/add-time/task/{id}.

tools.name: reclaim_log_work
tools.description: Log completed work time against a task. Reclaim REST: POST /api/planner/log-work/task/{id}.

tools.name: reclaim_delete_task
tools.description: Permanently delete a task. Reclaim REST: DELETE /api/tasks/{id}.
